checks.target: erase action eligibility gate and case-row deletion (store.py action op=='erase')
checks.required_behavior: Erase the eligible abandoned application's case row when stage=='abandoned'.
checks.observed_code_behavior: action() requires stage=='abandoned' then executes DELETE FROM cases WHERE id=? for the target cid; reachable via POST /case/<cid>/erase (app.py:0097-0099).

anchors.explanation: Eligibility gate on stage=='abandoned' followed by deletion of the case row.
POST dispatch to store.action with op 'erase'.

checks.target: business-retrievable copies: summaries, events, jobs (schema cascade)
checks.required_behavior: Summary, events and pending jobs for the erased cid are removed with the case.
checks.observed_code_behavior: summaries, events and jobs declare REFERENCES cases ON DELETE CASCADE; database() sets PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON per connection, so deleting the case row cascades to these dependent rows.

anchors.explanation: Cascade foreign keys on summaries, events and jobs.
Foreign key enforcement enabled on the connection used for the erase transaction.

checks.target: later job replay (drain) cannot resurrect the erased target
checks.required_behavior: After erasure, drain must not recreate events or change stage for the erased cid.
checks.observed_code_behavior: drain selects jobs WHERE cid=? from the jobs table; with the case and its jobs deleted there is no row to iterate, so no event insert or stage update for the target occurs.

anchors.explanation: Replay is driven solely by existing jobs rows for the cid; none remain after cascade.

checks.required_behavior: Deleting the abandoned target does not affect an unrelated active case.
checks.observed_code_behavior: get_case and dashboard queries are keyed by cid/owner/officer; DELETE targets a single id, so other cases remain retrievable.

anchors.explanation: Dashboard lists cases by owner/officer, unaffected by deleting another cid.

output.summary: The erase path (store.py:0210-0212) gates on stage=='abandoned' and deletes the case row; with PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON (store.py:0026) the ON DELETE CASCADE references on summaries, events and jobs (store.py:0039-0044) remove the business-retrievable copies. drain (store.py:0124-0143) iterates only existing jobs rows for the cid, so after deletion no replay can resurrect the target. Retrieval is per-cid/owner (store.py:0055-0058, app.py:0077), leaving an unrelated active case available. All in-scope targets are supported by static source reading.
